GPT-4-o is used for data generation (constructing context graphs), not as a judge to evaluate NLG outputs. The paper does not use LLMs as evaluators.

overall_notes: This paper is fundamentally about factuality detection/hallucination detection, not natural language generation. It evaluates fact-checking models (FactCG) on their ability to detect hallucinations in existing LLM outputs, but does not generate new text. The paper uses existing LLM-generated outputs from benchmarks like LLM-AGGREFACT for evaluation, but the core contribution is the fact-checking model, not NLG.
